blocks.html: Pagination, sorting, and field selection for retrieved audit logs.

types.name: select
types.description: The fields to return. All fields are returned when omitted. `id` is always returned.

types.name: skip
types.description: The number of audit logs to skip.

types.name: take
types.description: The maximum number of audit logs to return.

types.name: order
types.description: The sort order. Audit logs can only be sorted by when they started.
